consequence.statement: The metrics now reflect newly loaded certificates; this is a bugfix with no stated operational impact.

assertion.statement: The citadel_server_*_expiry_* certificate expiry metrics (root cert and cert chain, timestamp and seconds) now update when new certificates are loaded, instead of staying stale.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: bundles several changes: four distinct metrics, and no metric family exists in the subject schema; change: subject not pinned to a single schema family; a bugfix in metric update behavior; applicability: evidence does not state a configuration condition; effect depends on runtime certificate reloads
